text:
naomi: Quick sync 1. Final relnotes draft almost ready. Need a quick smoke for link redirects, snippet parity, and one Known Issue. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4991

ben: I'll run linkcheck now. Found two renamed anchors in /guides/quantize and /guides/migrate. Will open tiny redirect PRs.

rita: Snippet parity note: several pages still show old constructor `Client()`; we should standardize to `new RedwoodClient()` and `await client.responses.create(...)`. I'll make the sed patch.

sam: Known Issue suggestion: "Embeddings streaming may return intermittent 403s on long multi-chunk uploads; workaround: set batch_size=1 and enable prefix_cache." I have EVAL-2024-10-08 attached in the PR comments.

intl-bot: intl-checker: 2 files with placeholder order differences: /docs/quickstart and /docs/guides/embed-stream. Tickets created: INTL-950, INTL-951

naomi: Ok. Ben, merge redirects once CI is green. Rita, batch your snippet fixes into the relnotes PR so translators see final strings. Sam, add the Known Issue and repro link to the PR description.

ben: Redirect PRs opened and passing CI: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4992

rita: Pushed the snippet parity commit to the relnotes PR. Replaced constructor usage and updated JS + Python examples to include try/catch.

sam: Added Known Issue block and the short troubleshooting snippet in the PR. Also linked EVAL-2024-10-08.

naomi: Localization cutoff reminder: 2024-09-30 EOD UTC. Publish target: 2024-10-07 16:00 PT. After cutoff, please don't change strings unless critical.

ben: Merged redirect PR. CI green.

rita: Intl flagged placeholders fixed in my commit. INTL-950/951 now in review.

naomi: Great work. I'll do a final proof and cut the release branch after the intl thumbs-up. :shipit:
